name: Atelier: building taste
tagline: One artwork a day: study it closely, remake it, then read why it works
description: Each session centres on a single piece held by a real institution. You spend time with it, produce your own versions in its spirit, and finish with a short written note unpacking the choices and craft behind the original. Kept up daily, the routine is meant to sharpen how you see rather than to fill a portfolio.
